faq_heading: Homes near South Meridian Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the South Meridian Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the South Meridian Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names South Meridian Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near South Meridian Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 86 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,410,000, townhomes $808,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near South Meridian Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of South Meridian Elementary the median was 34 days on the market, closing at 96.9% of the list price, with 15% of sales above the list price for the 86 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to South Meridian Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Peace Arch Elementary (0.7 km west), Earl Marriott Secondary (1.1 km north-west) and White Rock Elementary (2.0 km west).

South Meridian Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 16244 13 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names South Meridian Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the South Meridian Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names South Meridian Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of South Meridian Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 86 homes sold within 1 km of South Meridian Elementary: 47 houses and 29 townhomes. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,410,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of South Meridian Elementary

10 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of South Meridian Elementary in a straight line (4 elementary, 3 secondary, 3 other; 4 independent). The closest is Peace Arch Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is White Rock Christian Academy, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Earl Marriott Secondary (1.1 km); the nearest independent school is St John Paul II Academy (2.0 km). Other elementary schools close by: Peace Arch Elementary (0.7 km west), White Rock Elementary (2.0 km west), Edgewood Elementary (2.1 km north-east), Jessie Lee Elementary (2.3 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Peace Arch Elementary, 0.7 km west of South Meridian Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near South Meridian Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from South Meridian Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near South Meridian Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of South Meridian Elementary was $1,410,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Peace Arch Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.7 km west of South Meridian Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
